signature.instructions:
You are doing business-listing deduplication (entity resolution). Decide whether listing A (input_name / input_address) and listing B (match_name / match_address) refer to the SAME physical place (the same business occupying the same spot).

Domain knowledge to apply:
- Suite/unit/floor/space/room designators, trailing suite letters, punctuation, and street-type or directional abbreviations (ST/STREET, AVE/AVENUE, BLVD/BOULEVARD, RD/ROAD, DR/DRIVE, HWY/HIGHWAY, N/NORTH, ...) are formatting noise: they do NOT make two listings different.
- Store/franchise numbers ('#7600'), legal suffixes (INC, LLC, CO, CORP), leading 'THE', singular/plural endings, '&' vs 'AND', and generic or cuisine descriptors (RESTAURANT, GRILL, KITCHEN, BAR, CAFE, MARKET, STORE, SHOP, FOOD, CUISINE, DINER, EXPRESS, and cuisine words like CHINESE or MEXICAN) are also noise WHEN the distinctive brand tokens already match. A listing named '<BRAND> RESTAURANT' and one named '<BRAND> <CUISINE> FOOD' at the same street address are the SAME place.
- Two listings must share a DISTINCTIVE brand token to be the same place. City, neighborhood, or landmark words (e.g. the city name, 'COLISEUM', 'CENTER', 'PLAZA') and generic descriptors are NOT distinctive: sharing only those is weak evidence and usually means two different businesses.
- One street address can host MANY distinct places: malls, stadiums, arenas, airports, office towers, food halls and strip centers. Different concession stands, sections, suites, gates, kiosks or tenants at one address are DIFFERENT physical places, even though the street address string is identical.
- The same chain brand at a different street number or a different street is a DIFFERENT physical place: answer False.
- `distance` is the separation between the two coordinates in meters. Under ~30 m is effectively the same point. Tens of meters at the same address with unrelated names means separate units. Over ~100 m almost always means different physical places, regardless of the address strings matching.
- Different brand names at the exact same address and essentially the same point can be a rename/rebrand (True), but only when the names or address details tie them together; when the names share no distinctive words, prefer False.
- `name_similarity` is a precomputed 0-1 token-level name similarity and `evidence` summarizes the deterministic address comparison. Treat both as reliable features.

Output only the boolean field is_same: True if they are the same physical place, otherwise False.

module_src:
class SamePlaceModule(dspy.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Only used for the genuinely ambiguous cases the deterministic rules can't settle.
        self.adjudicate = dspy.Predict(dspy.Signature(
            "input_name: str, input_address: str, match_name: str, match_address: str, "
            "distance: float, name_similarity: float, evidence: str -> is_same: bool",
            "You are doing business-listing deduplication (entity resolution). Decide whether "
            "listing A (input_name / input_address) and listing B (match_name / match_address) "
            "refer to the SAME physical place (the same business occupying the same spot).\n\n"
            "Domain knowledge to apply:\n"
            "- Suite/unit/floor/space/room designators, trailing suite letters, punctuation, and "
            "street-type or directional abbreviations (ST/STREET, AVE/AVENUE, BLVD/BOULEVARD, "
            "RD/ROAD, DR/DRIVE, HWY/HIGHWAY, N/NORTH, ...) are formatting noise: they do NOT make "
            "two listings different.\n"
            "- Store/franchise numbers ('#7600'), legal suffixes (INC, LLC, CO, CORP), leading "
            "'THE', singular/plural endings, '&' vs 'AND', and generic or cuisine descriptors "
            "(RESTAURANT, GRILL, KITCHEN, BAR, CAFE, MARKET, STORE, SHOP, FOOD, CUISINE, DINER, "
            "EXPRESS, and cuisine words like CHINESE or MEXICAN) are also noise WHEN the "
            "distinctive brand tokens already match. A listing named '<BRAND> RESTAURANT' and one "
            "named '<BRAND> <CUISINE> FOOD' at the same street address are the SAME place.\n"
            "- Two listings must share a DISTINCTIVE brand token to be the same place. City, "
            "neighborhood, or landmark words (e.g. the city name, 'COLISEUM', 'CENTER', 'PLAZA') "
            "and generic descriptors are NOT distinctive: sharing only those is weak evidence and "
            "usually means two different businesses.\n"
            "- One street address can host MANY distinct places: malls, stadiums, arenas, airports, "
            "office towers, food halls and strip centers. Different concession stands, sections, "
            "suites, gates, kiosks or tenants at one address are DIFFERENT physical places, even "
            "though the street address string is identical.\n"
            "- The same chain brand at a different street number or a different street is a "
            "DIFFERENT physical place: answer False.\n"
            "- `distance` is the separation between the two coordinates in meters. Under ~30 m is "
            "effectively the same point. Tens of meters at the same address with unrelated names "
            "means separate units. Over ~100 m almost always means different physical places, "
            "regardless of the address strings matching.\n"
            "- Different brand names at the exact same address and essentially the same point can be "
            "a rename/rebrand (True), but only when the names or address details tie them together; "
            "when the names share no distinctive words, prefer False.\n"
            "- `name_similarity` is a precomputed 0-1 token-level name similarity and `evidence` "
            "summarizes the deterministic address comparison. Treat both as reliable features.\n\n"
            "Output only the boolean field is_same: True if they are the same physical place, "
            "otherwise False."
        ))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        import re
        import difflib

        NAME_STOP = {
            "THE", "A", "AN", "OF", "AND", "AT", "ON", "IN", "INC", "INCORPORATED",
            "LLC", "LLP", "LP", "LTD", "CORP", "CORPORATION", "CO",
            "COMPANY", "DBA", "NO", "NUM", "NUMBER",
        }
        # Words that carry little identifying power on their own: business-type,
        # cuisine and venue-part descriptors.
        GENERIC = {
            "STORE", "STORES", "SHOP", "SHOPPE", "RESTAURANT", "RESTAURANTE",
            "CAFE", "CAFETERIA", "COFFEE", "BAR", "GRILL", "GRILLE",
            "KITCHEN", "MARKET", "MARKETPLACE", "DELI", "DELICATESSEN", "BAKERY",
            "PIZZA", "PIZZERIA", "SECTION", "FOOD", "FOODS", "CUISINE", "EATERY",
            "DINER", "BUFFET", "BBQ", "TAKEOUT", "EXPRESS",
            "CHINESE", "MEXICAN", "ITALIAN", "JAPANESE", "THAI", "INDIAN",
            "VIETNAMESE", "KOREAN", "AMERICAN", "MEDITERRANEAN", "ASIAN",
            "SUITE", "STE", "UNIT", "STAND", "KIOSK", "GATE", "CENTER", "CENTRE",
            "PLAZA", "MALL", "SERVICE", "SERVICES", "GROUP", "CLUB", "LOUNGE",
            "N", "S", "E", "W", "NE", "NW", "SE", "SW",
            "NORTH", "SOUTH", "EAST", "WEST",
        }
        STREET_MAP = {
            "STREET": "ST", "STR": "ST", "ST": "ST",
            "AVENUE": "AVE", "AVEN": "AVE", "AVE": "AVE", "AV": "AVE",
            "BOULEVARD": "BLVD", "BLVD": "BLVD", "BOUL": "BLVD",
            "ROAD": "RD", "RD": "RD",
            "DRIVE": "DR", "DRIV": "DR", "DR": "DR", "DRV": "DR",
            "LANE": "LN", "LN": "LN",
            "COURT": "CT", "CT": "CT",
            "PLACE": "PL", "PL": "PL",
            "PARKWAY": "PKWY", "PKWY": "PKWY", "PKY": "PKWY",
            "HIGHWAY": "HWY", "HWY": "HWY",
            "CIRCLE": "CIR", "CIR": "CIR",
            "TERRACE": "TER", "TER": "TER",
            "SQUARE": "SQ", "SQ": "SQ",
            "TRAIL": "TRL", "TRL": "TRL",
            "EXPRESSWAY": "EXPY", "EXPY": "EXPY",
            "PLAZA": "PLZ", "PLZ": "PLZ",
            "WAY": "WAY",
            "NORTH": "N", "SOUTH": "S", "EAST": "E", "WEST": "W",
            "NORTHEAST": "NE", "NORTHWEST": "NW",
            "SOUTHEAST": "SE", "SOUTHWEST": "SW",
        }
        UNIT_MARKERS = {
            "STE", "SUITE", "UNIT", "APT", "APARTMENT", "BLDG", "BUILDING",
            "FL", "FLR", "FLOOR", "RM", "ROOM", "SPC", "SPACE", "LOT", "BOX",
        }
        DIRECTIONALS = {"N", "S", "E", "W", "NE", "NW", "SE", "SW"}

        def clean(text: str) -> str:
            """Uppercase a string and turn every non-alphanumeric char into a space."""
            s = str(text or "").upper().replace("&", " AND ")
            s = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]+", " ", s)
            return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()

        def stem(tok: str) -> str:
            """Crude singular form so LIQUOR/LIQUORS and DONUT/DONUTS match."""
            if len(tok) > 3 and tok.endswith("S") and not tok.endswith("SS"):
                return tok[:-1]
            return tok

        def name_numbers(name: str) -> set:
            """Explicit numbers appearing in a name (store/suite/section numbers)."""
            return set(re.findall(r"\d+", str(name or "")))

        def name_tokens(name: str) -> list:
            """Normalized, stemmed word tokens of a business name (numbers dropped)."""
            s = clean(name)
            s = re.sub(r"\b\d+\b", " ", s)
            toks = [t for t in s.split() if t and t not in NAME_STOP]
            return [stem(t) for t in toks]

        def addr_parts(addr: str):
            """Return (house_number, street_token_list) from a street address."""
            s = clean(addr)
            toks = s.split()
            number = ""
            if toks and toks[0].isdigit():
                number = toks[0]
                toks = toks[1:]
            cut = len(toks)
            for i, t in enumerate(toks):
                if t in UNIT_MARKERS:
                    cut = i
                    break
            toks = toks[:cut]
            toks = [STREET_MAP.get(t, t) for t in toks]
            # drop a trailing tiny token (suite letter / unit number like "G", "101", "A1")
            while len(toks) > 1 and (toks[-1].isdigit() or
                                     (len(toks[-1]) <= 2 and toks[-1] not in DIRECTIONALS)):
                toks = toks[:-1]
            toks = [stem(t) for t in toks if t]
            return number, toks

        def ratio(a: str, b: str) -> float:
            """Character-level similarity of two strings in [0, 1]."""
            if not a or not b:
                return 0.0
            return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).ratio()

        def token_close(x: str, y: str) -> bool:
            """Two name tokens are 'the same word' (spelling variants / prefixes)."""
            if x == y:
                return True
            if len(x) >= 4 and len(y) >= 4 and (x.startswith(y) or y.startswith(x)):
                return True
            return ratio(x, y) >= 0.87

        def match_tokens(la: list, lb: list) -> list:
            """Greedy one-to-one pairing of tokens; returns the matched token pairs."""
            remaining = list(lb)
            pairs = []
            for x in la:
                for i, y in enumerate(remaining):
                    if token_close(x, y):
                        pairs.append((x, y))
                        remaining.pop(i)
                        break
            return pairs

        def set_sim(sa: set, sb: set) -> float:
            """Jaccard similarity of two token sets."""
            if not sa or not sb:
                return 0.0
            return len(sa & sb) / float(len(sa | sb))

        in_name = inputs.get("input_name", "")
        in_addr = inputs.get("input_address", "")
        m_name = inputs.get("match_name", "")
        m_addr = inputs.get("match_address", "")
        try:
            dist = float(inputs.get("distance", 0.0) or 0.0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            dist = 0.0

        na = name_tokens(in_name)
        nb = name_tokens(m_name)

        pairs = match_tokens(na, nb)
        matched = len(pairs)
        # Dice-style token similarity (never inflated by char-level noise).
        name_sim = (2.0 * matched / float(len(na) + len(nb))) if (na and nb) else 0.0

        # Distinctive (non-generic) words are what really tie two listings together.
        na_distinct = [t for t in na if t not in GENERIC and len(t) > 2]
        nb_distinct = [t for t in nb if t not in GENERIC and len(t) > 2]
        d_pairs = match_tokens(na_distinct, nb_distinct)
        matched_distinct = len(d_pairs)
        distinctive_shared = matched_distinct

        containment = bool(na) and bool(nb) and matched == min(len(na), len(nb))
        # All distinctive words of the shorter brand name appear in the longer one:
        # "<BRAND> RESTAURANT" vs "<BRAND> <CUISINE> FOOD" style pairs.
        distinct_containment = (
            bool(na_distinct) and bool(nb_distinct)
            and matched_distinct == min(len(na_distinct), len(nb_distinct))
            and matched_distinct >= 1
        )
        if (containment or distinct_containment) and distinctive_shared:
            name_sim = max(name_sim, 0.9)

        num_a, st_a = addr_parts(in_addr)
        num_b, st_b = addr_parts(m_addr)
        street_sim = max(set_sim(set(st_a), set(st_b)), ratio(" ".join(st_a), " ".join(st_b)))
        streets_match = bool(st_a) and bool(st_b) and street_sim >= 0.85
        streets_conflict = bool(st_a) and bool(st_b) and street_sim < 0.5
        nums_present = bool(num_a) and bool(num_b)
        nums_match = nums_present and num_a == num_b
        nums_conflict = nums_present and num_a != num_b

        same_address = nums_match and (streets_match or not st_a or not st_b)

        num_in_a = name_numbers(in_name)
        num_in_b = name_numbers(m_name)
        # Different explicit unit/section/store numbers embedded in otherwise different
        # names => two separate sub-units of one big complex.
        subunit_conflict = (
            bool(num_in_a) and bool(num_in_b) and not (num_in_a & num_in_b)
        )

        evidence = (
            "house_numbers=%s/%s (%s); streets=%s | %s (similarity %.2f); "
            "name_tokens=[%s] vs [%s]; distinctive=[%s] vs [%s]; distinctive_shared=%d; "
            "name_similarity=%.2f; distance_m=%.1f"
            % (
                num_a or "?", num_b or "?",
                "match" if nums_match else ("conflict" if nums_conflict else "unknown"),
                " ".join(st_a) or "?", " ".join(st_b) or "?", street_sim,
                " ".join(na) or "?", " ".join(nb) or "?",
                " ".join(na_distinct) or "?", " ".join(nb_distinct) or "?",
                distinctive_shared, name_sim, dist,
            )
        )

        decision = None

        # --- Deterministic rules -------------------------------------------------
        if same_address:
            if containment and distinctive_shared and dist <= 300.0:
                decision = True
            elif (distinct_containment and not subunit_conflict and dist <= 120.0):
                # Every distinctive brand word of the shorter name is present in the
                # other; remaining differences are generic/cuisine descriptors.
                decision = True
            elif name_sim >= 0.55 and distinctive_shared:
                decision = True
            elif distinctive_shared >= 2 and dist <= 120.0 and not subunit_conflict:
                decision = True
            elif na_distinct and nb_distinct and distinctive_shared == 0:
                # No shared distinctive word at all: separate tenants/units.
                decision = False
            elif name_sim < 0.3:
                decision = False
            elif dist > 100.0:
                # Same street address but coordinates far apart => different
                # units/sections of one large complex.
                decision = False
            elif subunit_conflict and name_sim < 0.7:
                decision = False
            elif name_sim < 0.45 and dist > 40.0:
                decision = False
            # else: same address, near-identical point, partially similar names -> LLM
        elif nums_conflict or streets_conflict:
            if (name_sim >= 0.85 and distinctive_shared and dist <= 20.0
                    and not streets_conflict):
                decision = None  # same brand, essentially same point, messy numbering
            else:
                decision = False
        else:
            # Address comparison is inconclusive (missing house number or street).
            if name_sim >= 0.85 and distinctive_shared and dist <= 250.0:
                decision = True
            elif distinct_containment and not subunit_conflict and dist <= 60.0:
                decision = True
            elif name_sim < 0.35 or distinctive_shared == 0:
                decision = False
            elif dist > 400.0:
                decision = False

        if decision is None:
            out = self.adjudicate(
                input_name=str(in_name),
                input_address=str(in_addr),
                match_name=str(m_name),
                match_address=str(m_addr),
                distance=dist,
                name_similarity=round(float(name_sim), 3),
                evidence=evidence,
            )
            raw = out.is_same
            if isinstance(raw, bool):
                decision = raw
            else:
                decision = str(raw).strip().lower() in ("true", "yes", "1", "same", "y")

        return dspy.Prediction(is_same=bool(decision))
